data.gender_notes: Alyosha is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Alexios means 'defender of the people'. The name Alyosha is a diminutive form of Alexios, and it became popular in Russia. This name was given to the main character in Fyodor Dostoevsky's novel 'The Brothers Karamazov'. The name Alyosha carries the meaning “Defender of mankind” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alyosha usually hope their child will grow to embody defender of mankind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Alyosha belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Defender of mankind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alyosha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: אליושה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אליושה הוא שם נרדף לאלישע, ראש כהן בממלכת ישראל, שליח ונביא, שכונה 'כבוד האלוהים' (2 מלכים א', 3). שם 'אליושה' הוא ריבוע 'אל' (אלוהים) ו'יוש' (שמו של יושב, המכונה גם 'אלישע'). האל 'יוש' הוא 'אל שישב' - 'האל שישב על כסאו' (ישעיהו ד', 2, ישעיהו נ', 1). שם 'אליושה' יצר שיח האלוהים, 'צדק' (ישעיהו ד', 2). שם 'אליושה' הוא 'אל' (אלוהים) ו'יוש' (שמו של יושב) - 'האל שישב' - 'האל שב בתפארתו' (זכריה, 1, 13).

in_greek.name: Αλύοςσα
in_greek.long_meaning: Αλύοςσα (Αλύοςσα) είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την希βηρική λέξη 'Αλύοςσα' και συνδέεται με τη λέξη 'Αλήση' (Αλήση), που σημαίνει 'πληρότητα'. Η λέξη 'Αλύοςσα' προέρχεται από τη λέξη 'Αλή' (Αλή), που σημαίνει 'πλήρης' ή 'τέλειος'. Το όνομα 'Αλύοςσα' σχετίζεται με την ιδέα της πλήρωσης ή της τελειότητας. Η λέξη 'Αλύοςσα' εμφανίζεται σε μερικές πηγές ως μεταφράση του ονόματος 'Αλήση' και έχει σχέση με την ιδέα της πλήρωσης.

The name Alyosha conveys a sense of wholeness and completeness, reflecting the Christian ideals of spiritual maturity and perfection. In modern times, the name Alyosha has been adopted by various Christian cultures, symbolizing a desire for spiritual growth and development.

data.cultural_impact: The name Alyosha gained significant cultural impact through Fyodor Dostoevsky's iconic novel 'The Brothers Karamazov'. Alyosha Karamazov is the moral and compassionate brother amongst the corrupted and troubled Karamazov family. His character embodies the Russian Orthodox Christian values of faith, forgiveness, and hope, reflecting the spiritual and moral struggles of the world around Him. This powerful depiction of the name Alyosha in Russian literature has left a lasting impression on Russian culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Alyosha carries a deep spiritual significance as it represents the Russian Orthodox belief that individuals can be protectors and defenders of their community, and indeed, of the people around them. Furthermore, the character Alyosha in 'The Brothers Karamazov' embodies the Orthodox Christian virtues of love, compassion, forgiveness, and spiritual introspection. The name itself is a reminder that every person has the potential to be a force of good in the world and to make a positive impact on those around them.
